questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 11 Bintang dan Galaksi

explanation.en: The Sun is the only star in our solar system.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 11 Bintang dan Galaksi

prompt.en: What is the Sun mostly made of?

explanation.en: The Sun is a ball of hot plasma made mostly of hydrogen and helium.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 11 Bintang dan Galaksi

prompt.en: What type of star is the Sun?

explanation.en: The Sun is a yellow dwarf star about 4.5 billion years old.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 11 Bintang dan Galaksi

prompt.en: The Sun has a solid surface you could land on.

explanation.en: The Sun is made of plasma and has no solid surface; the photosphere is its visible layer.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 11 Bintang dan Galaksi

prompt.en: Put these layers of the Sun in order from the centre outward.

explanation.en: Energy made in the core passes through the radiative and convection zones to the surface and beyond.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 11 Bintang dan Galaksi

prompt.en: What process makes energy in the Sun's core?

explanation.en: In the core, hydrogen atoms fuse into helium and release huge amounts of energy.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T3 Bab 9 Cuaca Angkasa Lepas

prompt.en: Match each kind of solar activity to its description.

explanation.en: Flares and CMEs can trigger geomagnetic storms, which make auroras and can disturb technology.

choices: Sudden burst of light and energy

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T3 Bab 9 Cuaca Angkasa Lepas

prompt.en: The Sun's activity rises and falls in a cycle of about 11 years.

explanation.en: About every 11 years the Sun's magnetic poles flip and sunspots, flares and CMEs peak.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T3 Bab 9 Cuaca Angkasa Lepas

prompt.en: Order these solar flare classes from weakest to strongest.

explanation.en: Each flare class letter is 10 times more energetic than the one before it.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 11 Bintang dan Galaksi

prompt.en: About how much of the solar system's mass is in the Sun?

explanation.en: The Sun holds about 99.8% of all the mass in the solar system.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 11 Bintang dan Galaksi

prompt.en: Match each part of the Sun to its temperature.

explanation.en: The core is hottest, but strangely the outer corona is far hotter than the photosphere.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 11 Bintang dan Galaksi

prompt.en: What will the Sun become in about 5 billion years?

explanation.en: When its hydrogen runs low, the Sun will swell into a red giant, then shrink to a white dwarf.

choices: A red giant, then a white dwarf
